Name: Use DIVIDE instead of division operator
Description: Use the DIVIDE() function to prevent divide-by-zero errors and return 0 or alternative value on error.

Name: Visible numeric measures must have format strings
Description: Provide an explicit format string for all visible numeric measures (currency, percentage, etc.).

Name: Avoid Bi-directional Cross Filtering
Description: Ensure relationships use single-direction filtering (1 -> *) to avoid circular ambiguity and improve query performance.

Name: All measures must have descriptions
Description: Provide clear descriptions for all measures to enable self-service BI and reduce support burden.

Name: Column names should follow naming conventions
Description: Use consistent naming: dimensions (Dim_), facts (Fact_), calculated (Calc_), measures in brackets [Measure Name].

Name: Hierarchies must contain related columns only
Description: Ensure hierarchies group logically related columns (e.g., Country -> Region -> City, not Brand -> Discount %)
